Afghanistan and Bangladesh Announce Asian Games Cricket Squads

Afghanistan and Bangladesh have announced their squads for the upcoming Asian Games cricket tournament. Afghanistan's selection has drawn attention due to the exclusion of prominent players like Rashid Khan. Bangladesh has named its captain for the tournament. The announcements were made by the respective cricket boards.
